DEN_Findal
Findal is a lightfoot halfling who can be found in the Underground Passage in Act One.
“
Oh, thank you, thank you. I thought I was going to die down here.
„
— Findal, after being rescued

Involvement

Act One

Findal is unconscious in the Underground Passage surrounded by  Gresh,  Gurza,  Torrack, and  Worm. The party can ignore him or enter the fray to defeat the goblins. If Findal's health is restored during combat, he joins the fight as an ally even if  Sazza is in the party. He explains that he had been gathering herbs nearby when the Goblins captured him to interrogate him about a weapon, of which he knows nothing about. If Findal survives the encounter with the Goblins, he warns the party that the Underground Passage is trapped before departing for the Grove. This grants ⁠A Timely Rescue for party members with the  Folk Hero background.

However, if Sazza is in the party, Findal realises he has stumbled upon a rescue attempt. The party can:

  • Deceive Findal into believing that  Halsin asked them to free Sazza  DC 15 Deception Check
  • Persuade Findal that Sazza will help them destroy the Goblin Camp  DC 15 Persuasion Check
  • Intimidate Findal  DC 15 Intimidation Check
  • Give Sazza to Findal

Failing a check causes Findal to become hostile and attack. If Sazza is given to Findal, both of them enter combat with each other.

If Findal is rescued before confronting  Kagha in ⁠Investigate Kagha, he will join the party in defeating the Shadow Druids.

If the Goblin Camp is dismantled before the party explore the Underground Passage, Findal's corpse is found along the path, and the  Key of the Ancients can be looted from him.

Companion approval

After the party rescue Findal, he expresses his gratitude, to which the party can ask questions or threaten him.

  • Don't thank me yet. I'm here to finish what they started.  +1 -1 -1

Speak with Dead

  • Who are you?
    • Findal
      Findal... druid... herbalist...
  • Who made this tunnel?
    • Findal
      We druids... concealed entrance... to our grove...
  • What were you doing down here?
    • Findal
      Hiding... goblins followed... from the forest...
  • What did the goblins want?
    • Findal
      Searching for... a weapon...
      • What do you know about the weapon the goblins are seeking?
        • Findal
          No weapon here... our ritual protects us...
          • What is the ritual that protects you?
            • Findal
              Rite of Thorns... seals the grove.

Notes

  • If Findal survives the goblin encounter and all the goblins are killed, speaking to him grants 10 XP.
